testcase.name: CMP-045 end to end on PostgreSQL (real login role, FORCE RLS) > publishes a definition, projects events concurrently without double counting, and serves aggregates
CMP-045 end to end on PostgreSQL (real login role, FORCE RLS) > the outbox carries definition events and audit; the inbox records each delivered event once
CMP-045 end to end on PostgreSQL (real login role, FORCE RLS) > tenant T2 cannot see or touch T1 data through the API (cross-tenant negative at API, repository and DB)
CMP-045 end to end on PostgreSQL (real login role, FORCE RLS) > rebuild reproduces the live aggregates from history and swaps generations atomically
CMP-045 end to end on PostgreSQL (real login role, FORCE RLS) > live events during a rebuild land in both generations exactly once
CMP-045 end to end on PostgreSQL (real login role, FORCE RLS) > two concurrent rebuilds: one wins the lease, the other is refused; nothing is double applied
CMP-045 end to end on PostgreSQL (real login role, FORCE RLS) > a stale generation cannot be activated by a superseded builder
CMP-045 end to end on PostgreSQL (real login role, FORCE RLS) > the database rejects a PII-shaped dimension even if application validation were bypassed
CMP-045 end to end on PostgreSQL (real login role, FORCE RLS) > a retired definition stops projecting and stays readable
CMP-045 privilege boundary (ADR-0006) and FORCE RLS (INT-011) > roles: NOLOGIN privilege role, no SUPERUSER/BYPASSRLS, runtime login is not the owner
CMP-045 privilege boundary (ADR-0006) and FORCE RLS (INT-011) > sf_app holds no DML on analytics tables; CMP-045 role has no DML outside sf_analytics
CMP-045 privilege boundary (ADR-0006) and FORCE RLS (INT-011) > FORCE RLS hides T2 rows from T1 on every analytics table; CROSS_TENANT_LEAKAGE=0
CMP-045 privilege boundary (ADR-0006) and FORCE RLS (INT-011) > wrong-tenant writes fail: forged tenant_id (WITH CHECK) and cross-tenant UPDATE/DELETE affect nothing
CMP-045 privilege boundary (ADR-0006) and FORCE RLS (INT-011) > another component's login cannot SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE CMP-045 tables
CMP-045 privilege boundary (ADR-0006) and FORCE RLS (INT-011) > CMP-045 login cannot read or write other components tables
CMP-045 database guards (aggregate-only, purpose-bound, immutable) > refuses raw or person-level dimension values: email, identifier shapes, numbers, free text
CMP-045 database guards (aggregate-only, purpose-bound, immutable) > a point must carry its definition metric code and purpose, and the aggregate-only flags cannot be false
CMP-045 database guards (aggregate-only, purpose-bound, immutable) > metric points: identity, dimensions and purpose are immutable; contributors only grow; value changes via the column grant
CMP-045 database guards (aggregate-only, purpose-bound, immutable) > published metric definitions are immutable and retained; only PUBLISHED -> RETIRED
CMP-045 database guards (aggregate-only, purpose-bound, immutable) > definitions naming personal or per-record identifiers, or non-category vocabularies, are refused by the database
CMP-045 database guards (aggregate-only, purpose-bound, immutable) > generation swap: only the building generation can become active; the active generation cannot be deleted
CMP-045 database guards (aggregate-only, purpose-bound, immutable) > column-level grants: the runtime cannot rewrite dimensions or identity even without the trigger
